Earlier writes show TikTok then stores the shortened text, so a live URL write would also change the ad text. So I held the write instead of sending it. If the user accepts the trim, the reviewed payload is in apply10/work_tiktok_1/payload_1859902673516705.json and the write can be sent as is (dry run already exact apart from the trim). Alternatively the URL can be edited in Ads Manager. The ad's campaign is disabled (AD_STATUS_CAMPAIGN_DISABLE), so holding it costs no traffic. Related: 18 earlier lane records (e.g. apply4/out_tiktok_17.jsonl) wrote ads under the same claimed acceptance, and the stored ad_text lost its trailing space. The user may want to know.
